data.body: Lint/typecheck evidence: change 1385 (patch set 2) merged to origin/main as commit 58f6545801 only after a green Verified +1 from the Gerrit Verified gate, whose 'build-and-test / lint + type-check' job runs 'make lint' (ruff check + format --check) and 'make typecheck' (mypy src/rebar, 432 files) on the patchset. Both passed there (and locally in this worktree) — the merge gate would have blocked otherwise. CI run: github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/30952601255 (analogous lint+type-check job green).
